prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone, but **Dr. David McFadden at The Dental Implant Center** looks like a strong Dallas option to investigate—particularly for complex restorations or full-mouth work. He is listed as board-certified in prosthodontics and oral implantology, and a provider directory reports a 5.0 rating from 208 reviews. Those credentials and ratings are useful starting points, not a guarantee of the best fit.

For implant **surgery**, you may also want an evaluation from a board-certified periodontist or oral surgeon; the right specialist depends on your gums, bone, and treatment plan. Consider getting two consultations and comparing the proposed procedure, risks, total cost, and follow-up care. Ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, and whether bone grafting is needed.

**The Dental Implant Center:** 5120 W. Lovers Lane, Dallas · (214) 956-9100.
